_comment: What the agent and the server must agree on. They are separate Go modules,
so neither can import the other's constants and nothing but this file ties
them together. Both test suites read it: apps/agent/internal/client and
apps/server/internal/api each assert their own side matches.
Adding a value here is not enough. The agent test fails if it can emit a
value this file omits, and the server test fails if it rejects one this
file lists, so a change has to land on all three or the build breaks.
_terminalMessageTypesComment: Every message type that crosses the terminal WebSocket. The server sends
open/input/keys/reply/resize/close to the agent and the agent sends
output/exit/error back; status and error also go to the browser. 'keys'
carries raw keystrokes; nothing screens them on the way, because the
server reads the shell's echo and applies the deny policy when a Return
arrives. 'reply' carries the console emulator's answer to a terminal
